 France vs. Turkey - Head-to-head record
 France historically dominate this fixture, winning five of seven encounters against Turkey, who have secured only one victory and one draw. The French also boast a superior goal difference, netting 14 goals to Turkey’s five.
 However, recent meetings show a more competitive dynamic. The last three encounters are evenly balanced, with France, Turkey, and a draw each claiming one result. This includes a 2-0 win for Turkey, a 1-1 draw, and France’s recent 1-0 victory.
 France’s recent 1-0 win occurred on Turkish soil, highlighting their ability to secure results away from home. Playing in front of their own supporters, France will aim to reinforce their dominance in the France vs. Turkey rivalry.

 France - In formidable Nations League form
 Here is a closer look at France’s current situation. We will highlight the team’s formidable momentum and their latest displays, before looking at how they might approach this new test against Turkey.
 Recent form
 France enters this match in formidable shape, especially in the UEFA Nations League . They are currently unbeaten in the competition after four games, securing three wins and one draw. During this run, they have scored a total of seven goals while only conceding two, demonstrating a solid balance between their attack and defence.
 The French attack has been particularly potent, with several players making significant contributions. Michael Olise has been the standout performer, finding the back of the net four times in just four appearances. Alongside him, attackers like D챕sir챕 Dou챕 have also been crucial, providing both goals and assists, making their frontline a constant threat to any opposition.
 Adding to their strong form, France will have a full-strength squad available for this encounter, with no reported injuries. This is a significant advantage, allowing them to field their best lineup. Considering their impressive overall record of 16 wins in their last 21 matches, a fully fit French team will be confident of securing another victory at home.

 Recent form

 Offensively, Turkey has struggled to create chances, scoring only three goals in five matches. Bar캇 Alper Y캇lmaz is among the few to get on the scoresheet, placing significant pressure on the midfield for attacking contributions.
 Turkey reports no injuries, allowing them to field their strongest lineup for this difficult away trip. However, their recent performances and low confidence make turning fortunes around in this France vs. Turkey fixture a truly monumental task. Expect a focus on defensive solidity to avoid another heavy defeat.

 Predictions for France vs. Turkey - A Comfortable Home Win
 France are in formidable form, especially in the UEFA Nations League where they remain unbeaten. With Michael Olise leading a potent attack, the hosts are expected to dominate from the start, making them a strong candidate to win the first half.
 In contrast, Turkey have lost all their matches in the competition and struggle defensively, conceding 13 goals. Their attack has been equally poor, so it seems unlikely that both teams will score in the first half, given the clear gap in quality.
 Considering Frances attacking strength and Turkeys defensive frailties, our main prediction is for a comfortable home victory. We are backing France to win with a “-1.5” handicap , anticipating a dominant performance in front of their own fans.
